claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The source clip is a medium-wide shot inside a concrete road tunnel lit by overhead sodium strip lights.
A driver in a grey overall crosses frame left to right around the black sports car with a carbon fibre body.
The image asset shows a driver in a red jacket and an empty showroom floor.

Ambient sound design is a permitted addition: a low engine rumble, tyre hum on concrete and a thin electrical buzz from the sodium strip lights, rising in pitch as the car advances. No audio track was inspected, so these are creative rather than observed.
The placed red-jacketed identity is positioned at the tunnel wall so that the target figure occupies a real place in the scene without borrowing the picture's showroom background, pose or lighting.

description.text: A static medium-wide view straight down a concrete road tunnel, the frame almost swallowed by darkness.

rests in the centre of the roadway, its low carbon-fibre body a soft unlit shape against the shadow pooled on the concrete, the long receding line of overhead sodium strip lights hanging dead above it. Near the left wall,
stands still in a red jacket, the only warm note in the gloom, face turned toward the car. On the right,
moves across the roadway, mid-stride, boots quiet on the concrete as he passes in front of the car.
Near-darkness with faint grain; only a thin sheen along the roof of the
and the dull housings of the strip lights separate from the black.
A low engine idle rumble under a thin electrical buzz from the tunnel lights.
The
carries his left-to-right crossing in front of the car, shoulders squared, slipping through the band of deep shadow.
The first sodium strip stutters alight and throws a harsh white pool across the concrete; the
rocks slightly on its suspension and begins to roll forward.
The
turns away from the wall, the red jacket catching the new light, and takes a half-step after the moving car.
The engine note thickens and climbs, tyre hum building under it.
The camera pushes in slowly, tightening the medium view as the tunnel wakes.
now sits fully in the pooled sodium light at the centre of the roadway, hard white highlights running along its carbon-fibre panels and a long shadow stretching back behind the rear wheels.
walks in the car's wake near the left wall, the red jacket sliced by light and shadow as he passes beneath each strip, while
carries his crossing past the rear of the car and falls away toward frame right, still in the same left-to-right direction.
A crisp white pool of sodium light on damp concrete, the
centred in it with a hard shadow line beneath the floor pan.
Engine note rising steadily, tyre hum rolling louder on the concrete.
The

The

The
steps forward into the lit band beside the wall, red jacket flaring bright, and follows the car's movement with his stride.
The slow push-in tightens on the lit nose of the car, highlight sliding across the carbon fibre while the tunnel behind sinks back into shadow.
